title: Integration of the Oura Ring and Maven Clinic Among Women Who Are Trying to Conceive
official: Integration of the Oura Ring and Maven Clinic Among Women Who Are Trying to Conceive: A Longitudinal Exploration of User Characteristics, Health-related Behaviors and Clinical Outcomes
summary: This study aims to characterize Oura Ring users who are trying to conceive. It also evaluates the feasibility and clinical outcomes of integrating Oura data with Maven's clinical support platform.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

18-45 years old Female sex at birth Currently trying to conceive Able to provide consent electronically Have an Oura Ring (Gen 3 or newer) with an active account Can communicate and provide consent using written and spoken English Lives in the US

Exclusion Criteria:

Currently using hormonal contraceptives Currently pregnant
